name: Paper-cut / layered paper
material: cut, folded and/or layered paper assembled into flat or shallow three-dimensional compositions
fabrication_process: build spacing for cast shadows in layered work
visible_production_marks: glue joins or tabs where visible
edge_behavior: Silhouette edges are crisp cut paper with tiny fiber irregularity; interior detail must be physically cut, drawn or layered—not infinitely fine floating linework.
mark_making: glue joins or tabs where visible
color_behavior: Color comes from paper stocks, paint/ink on paper, or light through layers; no inherent glossy plastic gradient.
surface_behavior: Matte fibrous surface; layers cast real shadows and reveal thickness; curled edges occur sparingly.
composition_behavior: Favor silhouette, negative space and layer depth. In pop-up/diorama mode, establish foreground/midground/background by physical spacing.
structural_limitations: every detached island needs a bridge/tab/support or must be a separate glued layer
paper cannot make infinitely thin unsupported hair strands
deep 3D volume requires folds/layers rather than smooth sculpting
aging_weathering: faded paper, edge fray, creases or stains only per state
new craft should remain clean and sharp

prompt_fragments.core: Build the image from physically cut paper shapes and layered depth: visible paper thickness, crisp cut silhouettes, tabs/joins or glued overlaps, real cast shadows and negative-space design.

typical_generation_failures: printed photo instead of cut structure
evaluation_criteria: cut edges and paper fibers read correctly

sources.supports: historic layered, folded, cut, painted and pasted paper construction

scope_note: This module controls material/production behavior. It does not select an era by itself.
